name: shead
description: A section heading inside the form: printed caps on the page ground, between the ruled rows. An h2, or an h3 under a card or panel heading.

level.description: h2 under the page heading; h3 where it sits inside a section that already has an h2.

text.description: Final copy, set in printed caps by the CSS.

states.empty: n/a: a heading always has text

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css D6 (.shead) and its auth context.
